words.enDefinition: an interview assessing the technical knowledge and skills needed for a role

examples.en: The technical interview included questions about how I had tested a class project.
examples.zh: 「技术面试」问到了我如何测试一个课程项目。

examples.en: I booked the technical interview for an afternoon when I had no lectures.
examples.zh: 我把「技术面试」约在一个没课的下午。

collocations: a technical interview for an internship

words.enDefinition: an early recruitment check to assess whether a candidate has basic technical skills

examples.en: The technical screening covered a few questions about the software mentioned in the posting.
examples.zh: 「技术初筛」问了几个与招聘启事所列软件相关的问题。

examples.en: I received another invitation after passing the technical screening for the summer placement.
examples.zh: 通过暑期实习的「技术初筛」后，我收到了另一份邀请。

words.enDefinition: a round in a hiring process that focuses on technical skills or judgment

examples.en: The recruiter said the technical round would take place after the first interview.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，「技术面试轮」会安排在第一轮面试之后。

examples.en: I asked how the technical round differed from the conversation with the hiring manager.
examples.zh: 我问「技术面试轮」和同招聘经理的谈话有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: writing and running code while other people watch, often during an interview

examples.en: The panel explained how live coding worked before opening the shared browser editor.
examples.zh: 评审组先解释了「现场编程」怎么进行，再打开共享的浏览器编辑器。

examples.en: I practised live coding with a classmate so I could explain my decisions clearly.
examples.zh: 我和同学练习了「现场编程」，好把自己的决定解释清楚。

words.enDefinition: a coding interview in which the candidate and another person work together on a task

examples.en: The pair programming interview felt like working through a small lab exercise together.
examples.zh: 「结对编程面试」感觉像两个人一起做一项小型实验练习。

examples.en: I asked how we would take turns coding during next week's pair programming interview.
examples.zh: 我问下周的「结对编程面试」将怎样轮流写代码。

collocations: prepare for a pair programming interview

words.enDefinition: an interview in which candidates show their thinking through work on a physical or virtual board

examples.en: The whiteboard interview began with a diagram of a simple library booking system.
examples.zh: 「白板面试」从画一个简单图书馆预约系统的图开始。

examples.en: I checked whether the whiteboard interview would use a shared board or paper.
examples.zh: 我核实了「白板面试」是用共享白板还是用纸。

words.enDefinition: a task in which someone works out ideas or a solution on a whiteboard

examples.en: I used a small table to organize my thoughts during the whiteboard exercise.
examples.zh: 在「白板作答练习」中，我画了一个小表格来理清思路。

examples.en: The interviewer explained the whiteboard exercise before asking me to draw the first step.
examples.zh: 面试官先说明了「白板作答练习」，然后请我画出第一步。

words.enDefinition: a task requiring someone to write or modify a program to practise or demonstrate a skill

examples.en: I worked through a coding exercise about grouping survey responses by date.
examples.zh: 我做了一道「编程练习题」，把调查回答按日期分组。

examples.en: The coding exercise asked us to read a list and return one number.
examples.zh: 这道「编程练习题」让我们读取一个列表并返回一个数字。

words.enDefinition: the software and settings in which a person writes or runs code

examples.en: The instructions listed the programming languages available in the coding environment for the test.
examples.zh: 说明列出了测验的「编程运行环境」支持哪些编程语言。

examples.en: I opened the coding environment early to check that the sample program would run.
examples.zh: 我提前打开了「编程运行环境」，确认示例程序能运行。

words.enDefinition: an editor that several people can access and use together

examples.en: I typed the function in a shared editor while the interviewer watched.
examples.zh: 我在「共享编辑器」里输入函数，面试官同步查看。

examples.en: The link opened a shared editor that already contained the prompt and examples.
examples.zh: 链接打开了一个「共享编辑器」，里面已有题目和示例。

words.enDefinition: code given at the start of a programming task to help the participant get started

examples.en: The starter code provided a function name and a few lines of sample data.
examples.zh: 「起始代码」给了函数名和几行示例数据。

examples.en: I read the starter code before making any changes to the shared file.
examples.zh: 改动共享文件之前，我先阅读了「起始代码」。

words.enDefinition: a small placeholder for a program part whose full behaviour is not implemented yet

examples.en: I replaced the code stub with a function that returned the required result.
examples.zh: 我把「代码桩」替换成了一个能返回所需结果的函数。

examples.en: The editor included a code stub showing the expected parameters and return type.
examples.zh: 编辑器里有一个「代码桩」，显示了预期的参数和返回类型。

words.enDefinition: example data provided to show how a program receives information

examples.en: I copied the sample input into my editor to check how the program responded.
examples.zh: 我把「示例输入」复制到编辑器里，看看程序会怎样响应。

examples.en: The prompt included sample input with three rows of ordinary student attendance data.
examples.zh: 题目给的「示例输入」有三行普通的学生出勤数据。

words.enDefinition: an example result showing what a program should produce for a given input

examples.en: The sample output showed that the result needed to appear on one line.
examples.zh: 「示例输出」显示，结果需要放在一行上。

examples.en: I compared my first result with the sample output in the instructions.
examples.zh: 我把第一次运行的结果与说明中的「示例输出」做了对照。

words.enDefinition: the result a test or program should produce for a specified input

examples.en: The exercise showed the expected output next to each set of test values.
examples.zh: 练习在每组测试数据旁边列出了「预期输出」。

examples.en: I wrote down the expected output before asking the program to process the empty list.
examples.zh: 让程序处理空列表之前，我先记下了「预期输出」。

words.enDefinition: limits on the kinds, size or values of data a program is expected to accept

examples.en: I read the input constraints to see whether repeated values could appear in the list.
examples.zh: 我读了「输入限制条件」，看看列表里会不会出现重复值。

examples.en: I checked whether zero was allowed under the input constraints before testing my solution.
examples.zh: 测试解法前，我核实了「输入限制条件」是否允许零值。

words.enDefinition: the required structure or arrangement of data supplied to a program

examples.en: The prompt specifies the input format above the first example with sample data.
examples.zh: 题目在第一个数据示例上方规定了「输入格式」。

examples.en: I clarified the input format before writing the function to read the values.
examples.zh: 在写读取数值的函数之前，我先确认了「输入格式」。

words.enDefinition: the required structure or presentation of a program's result

examples.en: The output format required one answer per line with no extra explanatory text.
examples.zh: 「输出格式」要求每行一个答案，不能加额外说明文字。

examples.en: I changed the spacing to match the output format in the sample.
examples.zh: 我调整了空格，以符合样例里的「输出格式」。

words.enDefinition: an unusual input or situation at the limits of what a system must handle

examples.en: The interviewer asked whether an empty list was an edge case in my solution.
examples.zh: 面试官问，在我的解法中，空列表属于「边缘情况」吗。

examples.en: I added another edge case before submitting the final version to the platform.
examples.zh: 向平台提交最终版本前，我又加了一个「边缘情况」。

words.enDefinition: a simple case in a recursive solution that can be handled without further recursion

examples.en: I named the base case first before explaining how the function called itself.
examples.zh: 我先讲「基本情形」，再说明函数怎样调用自身。

examples.en: The reviewer asked what the base case returned when no items remained.
examples.zh: 评审问，当没有剩余条目时，「基本情形」会返回什么。

words.enDefinition: the expected sequence of steps when all actions succeed and nothing unusual occurs

examples.en: I showed the happy path before explaining what would happen if an entry was missing.
examples.zh: 我先展示了「正常成功流程」，再解释缺少一项数据时会怎样。

examples.en: The coding example covers the happy path and one common mistake made by users.
examples.zh: 编程示例涵盖「正常成功流程」，也涵盖了用户常犯的一种错误。

words.enDefinition: a defined situation with inputs and expected behaviour used to assess a system

examples.en: I added one test case for a list containing two copies of the same value.
examples.zh: 我加了一个「测试用例」，检验列表里有两个相同值的情况。

examples.en: The first test case checked the result against figures supplied in the prompt.
examples.zh: 第一个「测试用例」用题目给出的数字核对结果。

words.enDefinition: a test whose details are withheld from a candidate or participant

examples.en: A hidden test case failed after my code had passed both visible examples.
examples.zh: 我的代码通过了两个可见示例，随后有一个「隐藏测试用例」没通过。

examples.en: The platform showed a hidden test case result without revealing the input values.
examples.zh: 平台显示了「隐藏测试用例」的结果，不过没有给出输入值。

words.enDefinition: a setup or program that runs tests and provides the support needed to check results

examples.en: The platform supplied a test harness that called my function with sample inputs.
examples.zh: 平台提供了「测试执行框架」，用示例输入调用我的函数。

examples.en: I left the test harness unchanged and edited only the function under review.
examples.zh: 我保留了「测试执行框架」，只修改了正在评审的函数。

words.enDefinition: a test that checks the behaviour of a small, individual part of a program

examples.en: I wrote a unit test for the helper function before changing its implementation.
examples.zh: 我在改辅助函数的实现前，为它写了一个「单元测试」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked why my unit test did not cover the empty input.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我的「单元测试」为什么没有覆盖输入为空的情况。

words.enDefinition: a collection of related tests run together to check software behaviour

examples.en: The test suite finished in a few seconds after I submitted the revised code.
examples.zh: 我提交改好的代码后，「测试套件」几秒钟就运行完了。

examples.en: I ran the test suite once more before handing in the exercise.
examples.zh: 交练习前，我又运行了一次「测试套件」。

collocations: add a case to the test suite

words.enDefinition: to meet the requirements checked by every test in a given set

examples.en: The platform reports whether you pass all tests before showing the final score.
examples.zh: 平台先显示是否「通过所有测试」，再给出最终得分。

examples.en: I had to fix the output spacing before the program could pass all tests.
examples.zh: 我得先修正输出里的空格，程序才能「通过所有测试」。

collocations: check that changes pass all tests

words.enDefinition: to follow or execute a program line by line to see what it does

examples.en: I asked for a moment to step through the code with the sample values.
examples.zh: 我请大家稍等，让我用示例值「逐步跟踪代码」。

examples.en: The interviewer suggested I step through the code to find where the count changed.
examples.zh: 面试官建议我「逐步跟踪代码」，找出计数值是在哪里变的。

collocations: step through the code line by line
use a debugger to step through the code
step through the code with an example

words.enDefinition: a task in which someone finds and fixes a problem in an existing program

examples.en: The debugging exercise started with a function that returned an incorrect average.
examples.zh: 「排错练习」从一个返回错误平均值的函数开始。

examples.en: I used a small list of numbers to check the result in the debugging exercise.
examples.zh: 我用一小组数字核对了「排错练习」中的结果。

words.enDefinition: extra information a program prints or records to help explain what is going wrong

examples.en: The debugging output revealed that the function processed the same row twice.
examples.zh: 「排错辅助输出」显示，函数处理了同一行两次。

examples.en: I removed the debugging output before sending in the final version of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我交练习的最终版本前，删掉了「排错辅助输出」。

words.enDefinition: a guided explanation of how a program or change works

examples.en: I used the code walkthrough to explain where each input value was handled.
examples.zh: 我在「代码流程讲解」里说明了每个输入值会在哪里处理。

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to start the code walkthrough at the main function.
examples.zh: 面试官请我从主函数开始做「代码流程讲解」。

words.enDefinition: to examine program text you have not worked with before in order to understand it

examples.en: I had to read unfamiliar code before I could explain its output.
examples.zh: 我得先「阅读不熟悉的代码」，才能解释它的输出。

examples.en: The interview tested how quickly I could read unfamiliar code without any documentation.
examples.zh: 面试考查我在没有文档时能多快「阅读不熟悉的代码」。

collocations: read unfamiliar code with a debugger

words.enDefinition: to improve how code is organized without changing its observable behaviour

examples.en: I asked if I could refactor the code after getting the tests to pass.
examples.zh: 测试通过之后，我问能不能「重构代码」。

examples.en: The reviewer suggested I refactor the code to separate data loading from calculations.
examples.zh: 评审建议我「重构代码」，把加载数据和计算分开。

collocations: refactor the code into smaller functions

words.enDefinition: to give variables names that make their roles or contents easy to understand

examples.en: I tried to name variables clearly so the interviewer could follow my approach.
examples.zh: 我尽量「给变量取清楚的名字」，方便面试官跟上我的思路。

examples.en: The feedback said I could name variables clearly instead of relying on single letters.
examples.zh: 反馈说，我可以「给变量取清楚的名字」，少用单个字母。

words.enDefinition: to tell another person what you are treating as true when reaching a result

examples.en: The interviewer asked you to explain your assumptions before writing down an estimate.
examples.zh: 面试官让你先「说明你的假设」，再写下估算值。

examples.en: It helps to explain your assumptions if the prompt leaves some details unspecified.
examples.zh: 如果题目没给齐细节，「说明你的假设」有助于别人理解。

collocations: explain your assumptions about the data

words.enDefinition: to check what limits or requirements apply before proceeding with work

examples.en: I asked about the dataset size to clarify the constraints before writing code.
examples.zh: 写代码前我先问数据集有多大，以「确认限制条件」。

examples.en: The candidate took a moment to clarify the constraints with the panel.
examples.zh: 应聘者花了一点时间向评审组「确认限制条件」。

collocations: ask questions to clarify the constraints
clarify the constraints with the interviewer

words.enDefinition: to separate a complicated problem into smaller parts that are easier to handle

examples.en: I drew two boxes to break down the problem before attempting a solution.
examples.zh: 我先画了两个方框来「拆解问题」，再尝试求解。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I would break down the problem for a new teammate.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我会怎样为刚加入的队友「拆解问题」。

collocations: break down the problem into steps
break down the problem before coding
help someone break down the problem

words.enDefinition: to say what you are thinking while you are working something out

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to think aloud while I tested the sample values.
examples.zh: 面试官请我在测试示例值时「边想边说」。

examples.en: I find it easier to think aloud when I start with a small example.
examples.zh: 我从一个小例子开始时，更容易做到「边想边说」。

collocations: think aloud while solving a problem

words.enDefinition: to outline how you might solve something before working out all the details

examples.en: I took a minute to sketch an approach on the shared whiteboard.
examples.zh: 我花了一分钟在共享白板上「勾勒一个解法」。

examples.en: The interviewer suggested I sketch an approach before starting to write the function.
examples.zh: 面试官建议我先「勾勒一个解法」，再开始写函数。

collocations: sketch an approach at the whiteboard
take time to sketch an approach

words.enDefinition: to examine the similarities, differences or trade-offs between ways of doing a task

examples.en: The question asked us to compare approaches rather than just give one answer.
examples.zh: 题目要求我们「比较不同解法」，不要只给一个答案。

examples.en: I used the sample data to compare approaches before choosing the simpler one.
examples.zh: 我用示例数据「比较不同解法」，最后选了更简单的一种。

words.enDefinition: to reduce a problem's complexity so that it is easier to work with

examples.en: I removed repeated entries from the example to simplify the problem at first.
examples.zh: 开始时，我把示例中重复的条目去掉，以「把问题简化」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked whether assuming a fixed input size would simplify the problem.
examples.zh: 面试官问，假定输入大小固定，能不能「把问题简化」。

words.enDefinition: a straightforward method that tries all or many possibilities instead of ruling them out efficiently

examples.en: I described a brute-force approach before showing how to avoid checking every possible pair.
examples.zh: 我先讲「穷举式解法」，再说明怎样省去对所有可能组合的逐一检查。

examples.en: The brute-force approach worked on the examples but took too long on larger inputs.
examples.zh: 「穷举式解法」能通过示例，但处理较大的输入时耗时太长。

words.enDefinition: to change a solution so it uses less time, memory or other resources

examples.en: I explained how I would optimize a solution if the input list became much longer.
examples.zh: 我解释了如果输入列表长很多，我会怎样「优化解法」。

examples.en: The exercise asked us to optimize a solution that already produced the right results.
examples.zh: 练习要求我们「优化解法」，这套解法已经能算出正确结果。

collocations: optimize a solution for memory use
look for ways to optimize a solution

words.enDefinition: to use extra memory in order to make a program or calculation faster

examples.en: I explained that keeping a lookup table would let us trade space for time.
examples.zh: 我解释说，保留查找表可以「用空间换时间」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked when it made sense to trade space for time in this solution.
examples.zh: 面试官问这个解法在什么情况下适合「用空间换时间」。

collocations: decide to trade space for time
trade space for time with a lookup table
an opportunity to trade space for time

words.enDefinition: how a program's required steps grow as the input size increases

examples.en: The interviewer asked how the time complexity changed when I added the inner loop.
examples.zh: 面试官问我加上内层循环后，「时间复杂度」怎么变。

examples.en: I compared the time complexity of both solutions on a diagram at the board.
examples.zh: 我在白板上用图比较了两种解法的「时间复杂度」。

words.enDefinition: how an algorithm's memory use grows as the input size increases

examples.en: I mentioned the space complexity after explaining how the program stored the results.
examples.zh: 我解释程序如何存储结果之后，提到了「空间复杂度」。

examples.en: The panel asked whether using another list would affect the space complexity.
examples.zh: 评审组问，再用一个列表会不会影响「空间复杂度」。

collocations: discuss the space complexity of an algorithm

words.enDefinition: the longest time a program is allowed to run before being stopped

examples.en: My first solution worked, but it exceeded the runtime limit for longer inputs.
examples.zh: 我的第一个解法能得到结果，但处理较长输入时超过了「运行时间上限」。

examples.en: I checked the runtime limit before choosing which sample to test first.
examples.zh: 我先查了「运行时间上限」，再决定先测哪个样例。

words.enDefinition: the greatest amount of memory a program is allowed to use

examples.en: The platform displayed a memory limit near the bottom of the problem description.
examples.zh: 平台在题目说明接近底部的位置显示了「内存用量上限」。

examples.en: I considered the memory limit before deciding whether to store every result.
examples.zh: 决定是否存下每个结果之前，我考虑了「内存用量上限」。

words.enDefinition: a result message saying that a program ran longer than the permitted time

examples.en: The result said “Time Limit Exceeded” after the platform checked the largest input.
examples.zh: 检测完一组里最大的数据后，结果显示「超出运行时限」。

examples.en: I saw “Time Limit Exceeded” twice before trying a less repetitive approach.
examples.zh: 我连续两次看到「超出运行时限」，后来试了重复计算更少的办法。

words.enDefinition: a result message saying that a program used more memory than permitted

examples.en: The platform reported “Memory Limit Exceeded” when the program tried to load every row.
examples.zh: 程序尝试载入所有行时，提交结果显示「超出内存用量上限」。

examples.en: I got “Memory Limit Exceeded” after adding a second copy of the dataset.
examples.zh: 我又存了一份数据集，接着就收到「超出内存用量上限」的提示。

words.enDefinition: an error a compiler detects while translating source code

examples.en: The compile error pointed to a missing bracket on the line above.
examples.zh: 「编译错误」提示，上一行少了一个括号。

examples.en: I fixed the compile error before checking the results with the sample input.
examples.zh: 我先修复「编译错误」，再用示例输入核对结果。

words.enDefinition: an error that happens while a program is running

examples.en: The runtime error happened when the code tried to read an empty list.
examples.zh: 代码尝试读取空列表时，出现了「运行时错误」。

examples.en: The platform showed a runtime error on one case but accepted the other tests.
examples.zh: 平台显示其中一个用例有「运行时错误」，其他测试都通过了。

words.enDefinition: a grading result showing a program finished but returned an incorrect result

examples.en: The platform showed “Wrong Answer” even though my program ran without an error.
examples.zh: 虽然我的程序运行时没有报错，平台还是显示「答案错误」。

examples.en: I got “Wrong Answer” when the program sorted names in the opposite order.
examples.zh: 程序按相反顺序排列姓名时，结果显示「答案错误」。

words.enDefinition: to send your work again after changing it or after an earlier submission

examples.en: The instructions say you can resubmit your solution before the window closes.
examples.zh: 说明说，在提交窗口关闭前可以「重新提交你的解法」。

examples.en: You will need to resubmit your solution after saving the corrected file.
examples.zh: 保存改好的文件后，你需要「重新提交你的解法」。

collocations: resubmit your solution before the deadline
be allowed to resubmit your solution
resubmit your solution after correcting it

words.enDefinition: a practice interview that uses questions and exercises like those of a technical interview

examples.en: A classmate ran a mock technical interview with me before the placement fair.
examples.zh: 实习招聘会前，一名同学给我做了一次「模拟技术面试」。

examples.en: The careers office offered a mock technical interview using an online shared editor.
examples.zh: 就业指导办公室提供了一次「模拟技术面试」，使用在线共享编辑器。

collocations: prepare for a mock technical interview

words.enDefinition: an interview where candidates explain how they would design a software system for a given purpose

examples.en: The system design interview asked me to outline a service for reserving study rooms.
examples.zh: 「系统设计面试」让我画出学习室预约服务的大致方案。

examples.en: I practised a system design interview with someone from the computing society.
examples.zh: 我和计算机社团的一名成员练习了「系统设计面试」。

collocations: prepare for a system design interview
questions in a system design interview

words.enDefinition: a description of the situation and goal for a design task

examples.en: The design prompt described a website visitors could use to reserve campus equipment.
examples.zh: 「设计题目」描述了一个供访客预约校园设备的网站。

examples.en: I highlighted the user groups in the design prompt before sketching the first version.
examples.zh: 我先在「设计题目」里标出各类用户，再画第一版设计。

words.enDefinition: a description of something a system must do

examples.en: I wrote down one functional requirement for checking whether a study room was available.
examples.zh: 我记下一项查看学习室是否空闲的「功能需求」。

examples.en: The panel asked me to show which component handled that functional requirement.
examples.zh: 评审组让我指出哪个组件负责满足那项「功能需求」。

words.enDefinition: a requirement about how well a system works or what constraints it must meet

examples.en: The interviewer asked for a nonfunctional requirement related to response time under heavy use.
examples.zh: 面试官要求给出一项关于高使用量下响应时间的「非功能需求」。

examples.en: I added a nonfunctional requirement about how long daily backups could take.
examples.zh: 我补充了一项「非功能需求」，规定每日备份最多可以用多长时间。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing the main parts of a system and the relationships between them

examples.en: I drew an architecture diagram to show how the booking service used the database.
examples.zh: 我画了一张「系统架构图」，展示预约服务怎样使用数据库。

examples.en: The panel asked why the architecture diagram showed two separate data stores.
examples.zh: 评审组问，「系统架构图」里为什么画有两个独立的数据存储。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing system components and how they relate or connect

examples.en: The component diagram separated the data storage from the part users interacted with.
examples.zh: 「组件图」把数据存储与用户操作的部分分开画了。

examples.en: I added labels to the component diagram so the interviewer could follow each connection.
examples.zh: 我给「组件图」加了标签，方便面试官理解每一条连线。

words.enDefinition: a limit that affects what can be built or how it can work

examples.en: The design constraint meant the prototype had to work on a smaller screen.
examples.zh: 这项「设计限制条件」要求原型能在更小的屏幕上运行。

examples.en: I asked whether offline access was a design constraint in the interview exercise.
examples.zh: 我问在面试练习里，离线访问是不是一项「设计限制条件」。

words.enDefinition: to approximate how much demand a system or process will need to handle

examples.en: The panel asked me to estimate the workload during the busiest hour of term.
examples.zh: 评审组让我「估算系统负载」，看学期里最忙的一个小时会有多少请求。

examples.en: I used the number of students to estimate the workload for the booking service.
examples.zh: 我用学生人数来「估算系统负载」，看预约服务需要承受多少使用需求。

collocations: estimate the workload for a service
estimate the workload at peak times
use sample figures to estimate the workload

words.enDefinition: a rough drawing of the main data entities and their relationships in a system

examples.en: My data model sketch showed which fields belonged to rooms and which to bookings.
examples.zh: 我的「数据模型草图」标明了哪些字段属于房间、哪些属于预约。

examples.en: I revised the data model sketch after the interviewer added a new record type.
examples.zh: 面试官加了一种记录类型之后，我修改了「数据模型草图」。

words.enDefinition: an outline of the operations, inputs and outputs that a software interface could provide

examples.en: My API sketch showed how a student might request a list of available rooms.
examples.zh: 我的「接口设计草图」展示了学生如何请求可用房间列表。

examples.en: The interviewer reviewed the API sketch before asking about how I would test it.
examples.zh: 问我会怎样测试之前，面试官先看了「接口设计草图」。

words.enDefinition: to explain what is gained and what is lost by making a choice

examples.en: The panel asked me to discuss a trade-off between accuracy and response time.
examples.zh: 评审组请我「讨论一项取舍」，即如何在准确性和响应时间之间权衡。

examples.en: I used the two diagrams to discuss a trade-off in the proposed design.
examples.zh: 我用两张图来「讨论一项取舍」，说明拟议的设计有得有失。

collocations: discuss a trade-off with the panel
discuss a trade-off between two goals
use an example to discuss a trade-off

words.enDefinition: an evaluation that candidates complete independently away from the interview before a due date

examples.en: The employer emailed me a take-home assessment after our first technical call.
examples.zh: 第一次技术通话后，雇主发来一份「限期独立完成的测评」。

examples.en: The take-home assessment asked for a short report using the supplied dataset.
examples.zh: 「限期独立完成的测评」要求用提供的数据集写一份简短报告。

words.enDefinition: a task designed to be completed within a specified amount of working time

examples.en: The time-boxed assignment was due Friday, but we were asked to spend only two hours.
examples.zh: 这项「限定用时的任务」周五截止，实际只要求我们用两小时完成。

examples.en: The time-boxed assignment helped the panel see what I would prioritize first.
examples.zh: 这项「限定用时的任务」让评审组看出我会优先做什么。

words.enDefinition: a task or set of questions used to evaluate technical skills for a role

examples.en: The technical assessment asked me to inspect two layouts and explain my recommendation.
examples.zh: 「技术能力测评」让我查看两种布局，说明我推荐哪一种以及理由。

examples.en: I received the result of my technical assessment the day after submitting it.
examples.zh: 提交「技术能力测评」后的第二天，我收到了结果。

words.enDefinition: the factors used to assess the quality or suitability of something

examples.en: I checked the evaluation criteria to see how much the report's explanation mattered.
examples.zh: 我查了「评估标准」，看看报告中的解释有多重要。

examples.en: The panel discussed the evaluation criteria before announcing how the task would be scored.
examples.zh: 评审组先谈了「评估标准」，然后公布任务怎样打分。

words.enDefinition: a list identifying each item that a task requires the participant to hand over

examples.en: The deliverable checklist included a spreadsheet and a short explanation of my results.
examples.zh: 「须提交的成果清单」包括一份电子表格和一段结果说明。

examples.en: I ticked off the deliverable checklist after saving the last file for submission.
examples.zh: 保存好最后一个待提交的文件后，我逐项勾选了「须提交的成果清单」。

words.enDefinition: a limited set of data provided as an example or for practice

examples.en: I loaded the sample dataset to see how the records had been organized.
examples.zh: 我加载了「示例数据集」，查看记录是怎样组织的。

examples.en: The sample dataset contained fewer entries than the one used for final marking.
examples.zh: 「示例数据集」里的条目比用于最终评分的数据集少。

words.enDefinition: a group of data records kept in their original form before cleaning or processing

examples.en: The raw dataset included some blank entries and a few dates in different formats.
examples.zh: 「原始数据集」里有几项空值，还有几个格式不同的日期。

examples.en: I saved a separate copy of the raw dataset before building the chart.
examples.zh: 制作图表前，我另存了一份「原始数据集」。

words.enDefinition: a task that asks someone to check and correct problems in a dataset

examples.en: The data cleaning exercise asked me to find duplicate entries in a small table.
examples.zh: 「数据清洗练习」让我查找一个小表里的重复条目。

examples.en: I documented how I handled blank dates in the data cleaning exercise.
examples.zh: 我记录了自己在「数据清洗练习」里怎样处理缺失的日期。

collocations: an example from the data cleaning exercise

words.enDefinition: a task that tests the use of spreadsheet tools to calculate, organize or analyze information

examples.en: The spreadsheet exercise asked me to total the attendance figures for each group.
examples.zh: 「电子表格练习」要求我算出各组出勤人数的合计。

examples.en: I added a short note explaining my formulas in the spreadsheet exercise.
examples.zh: 我在「电子表格练习」里加了条简短说明，解释自己用了哪些公式。

words.enDefinition: a task that tests the ability to explain what data shows and what can be concluded

examples.en: The data interpretation exercise asked why the trend changed halfway through the year.
examples.zh: 「数据解读练习」问趋势为什么在年中发生变化。

examples.en: I described two possible explanations for the chart in the data interpretation exercise.
examples.zh: 在「数据解读练习」中，我描述了图表的两种可能解释。

words.enDefinition: an exercise requiring a chart or other visual display to communicate information from data

examples.en: The data visualization task asked for one chart that showed differences between groups.
examples.zh: 「数据可视化任务」要求制作一张显示各组差异的图表。

examples.en: I chose a bar chart for the data visualization task because comparison mattered most.
examples.zh: 因为最重要的是比较，我为「数据可视化任务」选用了条形图。

collocations: a data visualization task for applicants

words.enDefinition: an interview in which a candidate analyzes a scenario and explains their reasoning to an interviewer

examples.en: The case interview asked me to estimate demand for an evening campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 「案例面试」让我估算校园夜间接驳车的需求。

examples.en: I practised a case interview with another student who was applying for consulting placements.
examples.zh: 我和另一名也在申请咨询岗位实习的同学一起练习了「案例面试」。

words.enDefinition: the description of the situation or question to analyze in a case exercise

examples.en: I read the case prompt again to check which city the example used.
examples.zh: 我又读了一遍「案例题目」，确认示例设在哪个城市。

examples.en: The case prompt asked us to consider both cost and access for students.
examples.zh: 「案例题目」要求同时考虑学生的费用和使用便利性。

words.enDefinition: the documents, figures or other evidence supplied for a case exercise

examples.en: The case materials included a map and last year's travel survey results.
examples.zh: 「案例资料」包括一张地图和去年的出行调查结果。

examples.en: I highlighted two figures in the case materials before presenting my recommendation.
examples.zh: 给出建议之前，我在「案例资料」里标出了两个数字。

words.enDefinition: an organized set of questions or categories used to analyze a case

examples.en: I suggested a case framework organized around demand, capacity and the available budget.
examples.zh: 我提出了一套「案例分析框架」，从需求、运力和可用预算三个方面分析。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to adapt the case framework to the information provided.
examples.zh: 导师让我根据给出的信息调整「案例分析框架」。

words.enDefinition: a question asking a candidate to estimate the size or demand of a market

examples.en: The market-sizing question asked how many students might use a new print service.
examples.zh: 「市场规模估算题」问一项新的打印服务可能有多少学生使用。

examples.en: I began the market-sizing question by estimating the number of first-year students.
examples.zh: 我先估算一年级学生人数，以此开始回答「市场规模估算题」。

collocations: an example of a market-sizing question

words.enDefinition: a quick approximate calculation made without detailed data or tools

examples.en: I used a back-of-the-envelope estimate to see whether the shuttle could break even.
examples.zh: 我用一次「粗略估算」看看接驳车能否收支相抵。

examples.en: The case interviewer asked for a back-of-the-envelope estimate before showing actual figures.
examples.zh: 案例面试官先要我做个「粗略估算」，再出示实际数字。

words.enDefinition: a calculation of the approximate level at which income would cover costs

examples.en: My break-even estimate showed how many tickets the student theatre needed to sell.
examples.zh: 我的「收支平衡估算」显示学生剧场得卖多少张票。

examples.en: The interviewer asked which assumptions mattered most for the break-even estimate in my notes.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我笔记上那项「收支平衡估算」最依赖哪些假设。

words.enDefinition: an assessment of how well someone uses and interprets numerical information

examples.en: The numerical reasoning test included a table comparing expenses across three university departments.
examples.zh: 「数值推理测验」里有一张比较大学三个部门开支的表格。

examples.en: I used the practice questions to learn the format of the numerical reasoning test.
examples.zh: 我做了练习题，熟悉「数值推理测验」的题型。

collocations: practise for a numerical reasoning test

words.enDefinition: an assessment of how well someone understands written information and reasons from it

examples.en: The verbal reasoning test asked whether each conclusion followed from the text provided.
examples.zh: 「文字推理测验」问每个结论能不能从给出的文字推导出来。

examples.en: I read the rules for the verbal reasoning test before opening the first passage.
examples.zh: 打开第一段材料前，我读了「文字推理测验」的规则。

collocations: prepare for a verbal reasoning test

words.enDefinition: an assessment asking how someone would respond to work-related situations

examples.en: The situational judgement test used a scenario about two tasks with the same deadline.
examples.zh: 「情境判断测验」用了一个情景，两项任务的截止时间相同。

examples.en: I checked whether the situational judgement test required one answer or a full ranking.
examples.zh: 我确认了「情境判断测验」是只选一个答案，还是给所有选项排序。

words.enDefinition: an activity in which participants act out assigned roles in a simulated situation

examples.en: The role-play exercise asked me to explain a late delivery to a customer.
examples.zh: 「角色扮演练习」让我向一位顾客解释为什么送货晚了。

examples.en: I received a short description of my part before the role-play exercise began.
examples.zh: 「角色扮演练习」开始前，我收到了一段简短的角色说明。

collocations: take part in a role-play exercise

words.enDefinition: an assessment requiring someone to prioritize and deal with a simulated set of incoming tasks

examples.en: The in-tray exercise included booking requests, an urgent message and a timetable conflict.
examples.zh: 「待办事项处理练习」里有预约请求、一条急讯和一处日程冲突。

examples.en: I explained why I dealt with the urgent messages first in the in-tray exercise.
examples.zh: 我解释了为什么做「待办事项处理练习」时先处理急讯。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation in which candidates complete a task together and their participation is observed

examples.en: The group assessment asked us to agree on a proposal within fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 「小组测评」要求我们在十五分钟之内就一份方案达成一致。

examples.en: I asked whether the group assessment would be followed by an individual interview.
examples.zh: 我问「小组测评」之后会不会有个人面试。

collocations: take part in a group assessment

words.enDefinition: a recruitment event in which candidates are assessed through several activities or exercises

examples.en: The assessment centre included a written task and a discussion with three other candidates.
examples.zh: 「集中测评环节」包括一项书面任务，以及和另外三名应聘者一起讨论。

examples.en: The recruiter sent a timetable for the assessment centre the day before it began.
examples.zh: 招聘人员在「集中测评环节」开始前一天发来了日程表。

words.enDefinition: a task assessing how someone organizes and presents information to an audience

examples.en: The presentation exercise asked me to explain my findings to people outside my field.
examples.zh: 「展示表达测评」让我向不同专业的人讲解研究发现。

examples.en: I had ten minutes to prepare for the presentation exercise after reading the chart.
examples.zh: 读完图表后，我有十分钟准备「展示表达测评」。

words.enDefinition: instructions explaining the topic, audience and requirements for a presentation task

examples.en: The presentation brief specified that each candidate should use no more than three slides.
examples.zh: 「展示任务说明」规定每名应聘者最多使用三张幻灯片。

examples.en: I checked the presentation brief to see whether we could refer to notes.
examples.zh: 我查阅了「展示任务说明」，看展示时能不能看笔记。

words.enDefinition: the first slide in a presentation, used to introduce the topic or speaker

examples.en: My opening slide had one photograph and the title of the campus project.
examples.zh: 我的「开场幻灯片」放了一张照片和校园项目的标题。

examples.en: I changed the opening slide after realizing the audience already knew the venue.
examples.zh: 发现听众已经熟悉这个场地后，我改了「开场幻灯片」。

words.enDefinition: the final slide in a presentation, often used to recap or invite questions

examples.en: The closing slide listed two findings and invited the panel to ask questions.
examples.zh: 「结尾幻灯片」列了两项发现，还请评审组提问。

examples.en: I added my contact details to the closing slide before exporting the file.
examples.zh: 导出文件前，我把联系方式放在了「结尾幻灯片」上。

words.enDefinition: a guide describing what to do or say during a demonstration

examples.en: The demo script reminded me to show the booking page before opening the settings.
examples.zh: 「演示脚本」提醒我先展示预约页面，再打开设置。

examples.en: I shortened the demo script when the recruiter confirmed how much time I had.
examples.zh: 招聘人员确认我有多少时间后，我缩短了「演示脚本」。

words.enDefinition: notes attached to a slide to help the presenter remember what to say

examples.en: I stored the exact figures in my speaker notes instead of adding them to the slide.
examples.zh: 我把精确数字记在「演讲者备注」里，没放到幻灯片上。

examples.en: The panel could see my slides, but the speaker notes stayed on my screen.
examples.zh: 评审组能看到我的幻灯片，「演讲者备注」只显示在我的屏幕上。

collocations: show speaker notes in presenter view

words.enDefinition: a practice attempt before the real event, often to check timing or equipment

examples.en: We did a dry run to make sure the video played during the presentation.
examples.zh: 我们做了一次「预演」，确认展示时视频能正常播放。

examples.en: My dry run showed that the final example took longer than I had planned.
examples.zh: 「预演」表明，最后一个例子比我计划的讲得更久。

words.enDefinition: the amount of time available or permitted to complete an activity

examples.en: The time allowance included both the presentation and any questions from the panel.
examples.zh: 「分配的时长」包括展示以及评审组提问。

examples.en: I checked the time allowance before deciding how many examples I could discuss.
examples.zh: 我先查了「分配的时长」，再决定能讲几个例子。

words.enDefinition: listeners who already know the specialized concepts relevant to a topic

examples.en: I included more detail about the measurements because the panel was a technical audience.
examples.zh: 评审组是「具有专业背景的听众」，所以我多讲了一些测量细节。

examples.en: The guide gave an example of explaining uncertainty to a technical audience.
examples.zh: 指南举例说明怎样向「具有专业背景的听众」解释不确定性。

collocations: explain findings to a technical audience

words.enDefinition: listeners who lack specialist knowledge of the subject being discussed

examples.en: I used an everyday example to explain my analysis to a nontechnical audience.
examples.zh: 我用了一个日常例子，给「无专业背景的听众」解释我的分析。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I would describe the result for a nontechnical audience.
examples.zh: 面试官问，我会怎样面向「无专业背景的听众」介绍结果。

collocations: explain a concept to a nontechnical audience

words.enDefinition: to begin an explanation by giving the most important result or decision first

examples.en: I decided to lead with the conclusion before explaining the data on each slide.
examples.zh: 我决定「先讲结论」，再解释每张幻灯片上的数据。

examples.en: The adviser suggested that I lead with the conclusion because time was limited.
examples.zh: 因为时间有限，顾问建议我「先讲结论」。

collocations: lead with the conclusion in a briefing
choose to lead with the conclusion
learn to lead with the conclusion

words.enDefinition: to give a short account of the most important results of an investigation

examples.en: I used one slide to summarize key findings from the campus travel survey.
examples.zh: 针对校园出行调查，我用一张幻灯片「概括主要发现」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked me to summarize key findings without reading from the report.
examples.zh: 面试官让我不照着报告念，「概括主要发现」。

collocations: summarize key findings in a slide
use a chart to summarize key findings

words.enDefinition: to describe what a chart shows and how to understand it

examples.en: I took a moment to explain a chart showing the busiest times of day.
examples.zh: 我花了一点时间「讲解一张图表」，上面显示了一天中最忙的时段。

examples.en: The panel asked me to explain a chart without referring to the written notes.
examples.zh: 评审组让我不看笔记，「讲解一张图表」。

collocations: explain a chart to an audience
learn how to explain a chart

words.enDefinition: to state honestly where a method, result or conclusion may be incomplete

examples.en: I made sure to acknowledge limitations caused by the small number of survey responses.
examples.zh: 我特地「指出局限性」，说明问卷回复太少会有什么影响。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to acknowledge limitations before proposing my preferred option.
examples.zh: 导师让我先「指出局限性」，再提出我更倾向的选项。

words.enDefinition: to explain what you think should be done, usually with supporting reasons

examples.en: You have five minutes to present your recommendation before the panel asks questions.
examples.zh: 评审组提问前，有五分钟可以「陈述你的建议方案」。

examples.en: The tutor suggested that you present your recommendation before outlining the alternatives.
examples.zh: 导师建议先「陈述你的建议方案」，再概述其他选项。

collocations: present your recommendation to the panel
present your recommendation at the end

words.enDefinition: a slide presenting a proposed decision or course of action

examples.en: The recommendation slide explains why I chose the cheaper option for the pilot.
examples.zh: 「建议方案幻灯片」解释了我为什么为试点选了更便宜的方案。

examples.en: I added one comparison figure to the recommendation slide before presenting to the panel.
examples.zh: 向评审组展示前，我在「建议方案幻灯片」上加了一个对比数字。

words.enDefinition: to show only one open application window to others in an online meeting

examples.en: I chose to share a window so the interview panel saw only my editor.
examples.zh: 我选择「共享某个窗口」，这样评审组只能看到我的编辑器。

examples.en: The platform showed me how to share a window during the online presentation.
examples.zh: 平台指示了在线展示时怎样「共享某个窗口」。

collocations: share a window with the panel

words.enDefinition: a display mode that shows slides to an audience at presentation size

examples.en: I switched to slide show view before the interview panel joined the online call.
examples.zh: 评审组加入在线通话前，我切换到了「放映视图」。

examples.en: The slides filled the screen once I started slide show view on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本电脑上启用「放映视图」后，幻灯片铺满了屏幕。

words.enDefinition: extra slides kept outside the main presentation for use if more detail is requested

examples.en: I kept two backup slides in case the panel asked about the survey method.
examples.zh: 我留了两张「备用幻灯片」，以备评审组问到调查方法。

examples.en: The interviewer asked a question that I could answer using my backup slides.
examples.zh: 面试官问了一个问题，我能用「备用幻灯片」回答。

words.enDefinition: a presentation recorded in advance for the audience to watch later

examples.en: The panel accepted a pre-recorded presentation because our schedules did not overlap.
examples.zh: 由于大家的时间对不上，评审组接受了「预先录制的展示」。

examples.en: I tested the captions before submitting my pre-recorded presentation through the portal.
examples.zh: 通过平台提交「预先录制的展示」之前，我检查了字幕。

words.enDefinition: a quick test to verify that a camera works and the video is framed suitably

examples.en: I did a camera check before starting the recorded presentation on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我开始用笔记本录演示前，做了一次「摄像头测试」。

examples.en: The camera check showed that the light behind me made my face too dark.
examples.zh: 「摄像头测试」发现，我身后的灯让脸显得太暗。

words.enDefinition: a test to confirm that an online connection can support a call or task

examples.en: I ran a connection check before opening the link for the technical interview.
examples.zh: 打开技术面试链接前，我做了「连接测试」。

examples.en: The connection check kept failing until I moved to a room with stronger Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 我换到无线网信号更好的房间后，「连接测试」才通过。

words.enDefinition: an online board that several participants can view or mark on together

examples.en: The shared whiteboard let me draw the diagram while the interviewer added labels.
examples.zh: 在「共享白板」上，我画示意图的同时，面试官可以加标签。

examples.en: I reopened the shared whiteboard after the meeting to read my own notes.
examples.zh: 开完会我又打开「共享白板」，查看自己写的笔记。

words.enDefinition: to test whether an idea taken as true is supported by available evidence

examples.en: I used the survey to validate an assumption that students wanted a later shuttle.
examples.zh: 我用问卷来「验证一项假设」，即学生希望接驳车运营到更晚。

examples.en: The panel asked how I would validate an assumption before relying on the estimate.
examples.zh: 评审组问，在采用估算值之前，我会怎样「验证一项假设」。

words.enDefinition: to locate a stage whose limited capacity holds up the rest of a process

examples.en: I timed each step to identify a bottleneck in the sample booking process.
examples.zh: 我为每一步计时，想在这个预约流程示例里「找出瓶颈」。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how I could identify a bottleneck without access to the full dataset.
examples.zh: 面试官问，没有完整的数据集，我怎样「找出瓶颈」。

collocations: identify a bottleneck in a process
use measurements to identify a bottleneck

words.zhGloss: 对解法做性能基准测试
words.enDefinition: to measure a solution's performance under defined conditions so it can be compared
acceptedZhAnswers: 对解法做性能基准测试

examples.en: I used the same test data to benchmark a solution against the original version.
examples.zh: 我用同样的测试数据「对解法做性能基准测试」，以便比较它和原来的版本。

examples.en: The interviewer asked how we would benchmark a solution when inputs varied in size.
examples.zh: 面试官问，输入规模变化时，我们怎样「对解法做性能基准测试」。

collocations: benchmark a solution against a baseline
benchmark a solution on larger inputs
use test data to benchmark a solution

words.enDefinition: a question asking how the answer or outcome might change under different conditions

examples.en: The panel asked a what-if question about the service running during a power cut.
examples.zh: 评审组问了一个「假设性问题」，假设停电时服务还要运行。

examples.en: I answered a what-if question about demand doubling at the start of term.
examples.zh: 我回答了一个「假设性问题」，假设开学时需求翻倍。

collocations: a what-if question about rising demand
